title: Second Lieutenant R Lancaster
memorial_details: description: TO THE GLORY OF GOD/ AND IN LOVING REMEMBRANCE OF/ ROBERT LANCASTER/ SECOND LIEUTENANT NORFOLK REGIMENT/ THIRD SON OF SIR WILLIAM LANCASTER/ AND THE LATE SARAH HARRIOT HIS WIFE/ OF PUTNEY HILL SOMETIME CHURCHWARDEN/ OF THIS CHURCH WHO FELL IN THE BATTLE OF/ ARRAS 28TH APRIL 1917/ The souls of the righteous are in the hand of God/
